name: Professional / Individual
description: Freelancers, independent professionals and specialists. Deliberately the lightest set: an individual has no incorporation certificate, and demanding one is the single most common reason good freelancers abandon onboarding.

fields.label: Profession / specialisation
fields.why: We verify this against any professional registration you hold.

fields.label: Engagement basis
fields.why: Sets how we process your invoices.

fields.label: Professional body registration
fields.why: Regulated professions (medical, legal, audit, engineering) require a current registration.

documents.label: Certificate of incorporation
documents.why: Not applicable — an individual professional is not an incorporated entity. Your government ID stands in as proof of identity.

documents.label: Tax registration certificate
documents.why: Only if you are registered for tax. Many independent professionals fall below the registration threshold, and we do not require it of them.
documents.expects: A tax registration certificate naming the individual or their practice

documents.label: Government photo ID
documents.why: For an individual vendor this replaces the certificate of incorporation as proof of identity.

documents.label: Professional certification / licence
documents.why: Confirms the professional registration you provided is current.
documents.expects: A professional body certificate or practising licence naming the individual

documents.label: Portfolio / work samples
documents.why: Optional. Helps the requesting team evaluate fit; never used in the compliance decision.
